contexts.text: See Beast. AC 2781.
Lamb, kid, and calf () = the three degrees of innocence and love.
The lambs and sheep which were sacrificed, represented celestial things.
He shall carry the lambs in His bosom.
When lambs appear in the World of Spirits, they know that the Angels are discoursing about goods still more interior, and about innocence.
Celestial good was represented by the sacrifice of a lamb.
Abraham set seven ewe-lambs of the flock by themselves () = the holiness of innocence.
Therefore the Nazarite was to sacrifice a he-lamb and a ewe-lamb () by which was signified the Celestial. AC 10132:10.
Lamb () = celestial things.
That the lambs which were offered in the burnt-offering and sacrifice, were lambs of their year (, etc.) = the celestial things of innocence in the Lord's Kingdom, which are eternal.
They are said to follow the Lamb whithersoever He goeth; for by the Lamb is meant the Lord as to innocence. AC 3325:6.
Lambs, rams, and he-goats () = spiritual goods and truths.
He-lambs and she-lambs (as sacrificed) = the innocence of the internal or rational man.
All the black cattle in the lambs () = the proprium of the innocence which belongs to the good signified by Laban... A lamb = innocence.
Whereas the white in the lambs = the merit which is placed in goods.
That lambs = innocence. Illustrated.
The wolf shall dwell with the lamb ()... The lamb = those who are in innocence.
The wolf and the lamb shall pasture together ()... The lamb = those who are in innocence.
As the wolf and the lamb are opposites, the Lord said to the seventy... Behold I send you forth as lambs into the midst of wolves ().
The fat of lambs () = the charity of innocence.

Lambs, in the Original Language, are expressed by various names, and thereby are signified different degrees of innocence; for in all good there must be innocence... and thence also in truth. Here, lambs are expressed by a word by which sheep also are expressed (Illustrated.); and it is the innocence of the faith which is of charity which is signified. Lambs are expressed by other words elsewhere. Illustrated.
To gather the lambs into His arm () = those who are in charity in which is innocence.

As there is no charity and love except from innocence, the Lord first asks Peter whether he loves Him; that is, whether there is love in the faith, and then says, Feed My lambs (); that is, those who are in innocence. AC 4169:3. AC 10087:3.
As the Lord is the innocence itself which is in His Kingdom, for all innocence is from Him, He is called the Lamb. Illustrated.

It is known that the paschal lamb, in the supreme sense, = the Lord... In the representative sense, the paschal lamb = that which is essential of regeneration, namely, innocence; for no one can be regenerated except through charity in which is innocence.

As innocence is the primary thing in the Lord's Kingdom, and is the Celestial itself there, and as the sacrifices and burnt-offerings represented the spiritual and celestial things of the Lord's Kingdom; therefore the essential itself of His Kingdom, which is innocence, was represented by the lambs; and therefore the continual burnt-offering was made of lambs, one in the morning, and the other between the evenings... and two on the Sabbath days... and by still more lambs on stated feasts. Illustrated.

The reason a parturient woman, after the days of her cleansing were passed, was to offer a lamb for a burnt-offering, or a young dove, or a turtle, (), was that there might be signified the effect of conjugial love, which is innocence; and because infants = innocence. AC 10132:9.
Hence it is that spotted, in the Original Language, is expressed by a word which also means lambs. Illustrated.
And Jacob separated the lambs () = as to innocence; (for) lambs = innocence.
Under Flock, see this reference.
Under Innocence, see this reference.
A lamb, or a she-goat, which, here, are a small cattle = innocence; a lamb, the innocence of the interior man...
By a burnt-offering from a lamb () is meant the worship of the Lord from the good of innocence.
Thou shalt take from the lambs and from the she-goats () = the good of innocence interior and exterior. Explained.
The blood of the Lamb = innocent blood; for the Lamb = innocence.
The burnt-offering from lambs, etc. = the worship of the Lord from the quality of that good (that is, from good not as yet fully purified).
Lambs and sheep signified the good of innocence and of charity in the internal or spiritual man...
To eat the lambs from the flock () = to learn and appropriate to themselves the goods of innocence which are of the internal or spiritual man.
The purification of the internal itself, which is inmost, was represented by the burnt-offerings and sacrifices from lambs. AC 10042:8.
Two lambs the sons of a year every day (constantly) () = the good of innocence in every state (in all Divine worship). Lambs = the good of innocence. Illustrated.
The inmost good of innocence is signified by a lamb ().

That a lamb = the good of innocence in general; and, in special, the inmost good of innocence, may be evident from the fact that it is mentioned in the first place; and also from the fact that the Lord Himself is called the Lamb.
As the Lord when in the world was, as to His Human, innocence itself; and as, therefore, all innocence proceeds from Him, He is called the Lamb, and the Lamb of God. Illustrated.

As lambs = those who are in innocence, the Lord said to Peter, first, Feed My lambs... Lambs, here, = those who are in the good of love to the Lord; for these are in the good of innocence above all others.

As by lambs are meant those who are in love to Him, thus in the good of innocence, it is said, that He will gather them in His arm, and carry them in His bosom; for they are conjoined with the Lord by love...

From these things it may now be evident what is signified by the burnt-offerings and sacrifices from lambs, and why they were made every day, every Sabbath, every new moon, and every feast; on the feast of the passover, each day; and why, at the feast of the passover, a lamb was eaten, which was called the paschal lamb. Illustrated, Explained.

From these things it may be evident that by a lamb is signified the good of innocence... This is especially evident from the fact that the Lord Himself is called the Lamb... and also that those are called lambs who love the Lord. Illustrated.

The good of innocence is signified not only by a lamb, but also by a ram, and a bullock; but with this difference, that by a lamb is signified the inmost good of innocence... (Continued. See Innocence.) AC 10137:10.

Its being said that the lamb which was offered in the burnt-offering was to be the son of a year, signified that when a lamb exceeded a year it was a sheep; and as a lamb was as it were the infant of a sheep, there was signified by it such good as is of infancy, which is the good of innocence. Hence also it was, that lambs were offered for a burnt-offering in the first month of the year, when the passover was... also on the day of the firstfruits... and on the day in which they waved the sheaf. Illustrated. For by (these times) there was also signified a state of infancy, thus a state of innocence.

It treats of purification from evils and falsities by the good of innocence; for this good is signified by lambs; and the purification from evils and the derivative falsities, by the burnt-offering from them...
Sheep and lambs correspond to affections of the spiritual mind.
Hence the Lord is called the Lamb; for a lamb = innocence.
By God and the Lamb is meant the Lord as to the Divine Itself and the Divine Human.
A lamb (in the Word) = innocence.
Preface [2]. The Lamb = the Lord as to the Divine Human. AR 6. AR 256. AR 288. AR 291. AR 339. AR 368.
A lamb slain () = His Human not acknowledged in the Church as Divine. AR 589. AE 315.
When the Lamb opened the first of the seals () = exploration by the Lord...

The Lamb who is in the midst of the throne shall feed them () = that the Lord alone will teach them. By the Lamb in the midst of the throne is signified the Lord as to the Divine Human in the inmost, and thus in all things of Heaven.
The names not written in the Lamb's book of life () = except those who believe in the Lord.

He had two horns like a lamb () = that they vaunt their things as if they were Divine truths of the Lord, because from the Word; for by a lamb is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human, and also as to the Word, which is the Divine truth from the Divine good. Hence it is that upon this beast, which is also the false prophet, there appeared two horns like a lamb...
Behold a Lamb standing upon the Mount Sion... () = the Lord now in the New Heaven... by the Lamb is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human.

It is said (he shall be tormented) before the Angels and the Lamb () because these loves are against Divine truths, and against the Lord who is the Word; for by... the Lamb is signified the Lord as to the Divine Human, and at the same time as to the Word. AR 743.
By the song of the Lamb () is signified confession from faith concerning the Divinity of the Lord's Human; for by the Lamb is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human. AR 918. AR 932.

These shall fight with the Lamb, but the Lamb shall overcome them; because He is Lord of lords and King of kings () = the Lord's combat with them concerning the acknowledgement of His Divine Human, because in it the Lord is the God of Heaven and earth, and also the Word.

For the marriage of the Lamb is come () = because henceforth there is a full marriage of the Lord and the Church. In order that this may be signified, it is said the Lamb, and by the Lamb is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human. AE 1219.
The Lamb = the Lord. AR 919. AR 925.
Where he-lambs and she-lambs were pasturing.
Who does not know that the Lord was not that Lamb, nor in that Lamb; but that the Lamb was a representation of His innocence?
As (the Moravians) do not acknowledge the Lord as God, but as a man, in common discourse they call Him the Lamb, and by this they understand one who is innocent. SE 4810.
Lambs = those who are in the good of innocence and of love to the Lord. References.
Lambs = celestial good. References.
The Lamb = His Divine Human.
To eat the lambs from the flock = to imbibe the Knowledges of internal good, or of the spiritual man.
The Divine truth from the Lord is called the Son of Man, but here the Lamb.
God = the Lord as to Divine good; and the Lamb, as to Divine truth.
A Lamb standing = the Lord as to the Divine Human... because a lamb = the good of innocence, and the good of innocence is the good itself of Heaven which proceeds from the Lord...

It is believed... that the Lord is called the Lamb from the fact that the continual burnt-offering... was of lambs, and especially on the days of the passover when a lamb was also eaten, and because the Lord suffered Himself to be sacrificed; but this reason for the name is for those... who do not think beyond the sense of the letter... But in Heaven... when a lamb is mentioned, or when lamb is read in the Word, then the Angels... perceive the good of innocence; and when the Lord is so called, they perceive His Divine Human, and at the same time the good of innocence which is from Him. AE 314:2, Illustrated.

By the lambs which He will gather in His arms are signified those who are in love to Him. This love is that which, regarded in itself, is innocence... and because this love is signified by lambs, it is also said He shall gently lead those which are sucklings.
A lamb = innocence of the inmost degree...
As a lamb = innocence...
As lambs = those who are in love to the Lord, which love is one with innocence...
By lambs, etc. are signified the three degrees of the good of innocence... AE 314:8.

As by a lamb is signified innocence, which, regarded in itself, is love to the Lord, therefore by a lamb, in the supreme sense, is signified the Lord as to the Divine Human; for the Lord as to that was innocence itself Illustrated.

As... the burnt-offerings signified all representative worship from the good of love... therefore every day, morning and evening, a burnt-offering of lambs was made. On every Sabbath, of two lambs, besides the continual burnt-offering of them. At the beginnings of the months, of seven lambs. In like manner on the day of the first-fruits. In like manner in the seventh month, when there was a holy convocation. In like manner, to wit, of seven lambs on each day of the passover... Illustrated.
On account of this representation, there was also instituted the paschal supper of lambs, or kids (); for by the feast of the passover there was represented the glorification of the Lord's Human.
The Lamb = the Lord as to the Divine Human. AE 456. AE 864.
The Lamb = the Divine truth proceeding.
The Lamb = the Lord as to Divine truth. AE 460. AE 482. AE 936.

It is said He that sitteth upon the throne, and the Lamb, and by both is meant the Lord; by He that sitteth upon the throne, Himself as to the Divine good; and by the Lamb, Himself as to Divine truth, both from His Divine Human... and therefore also elsewhere there is mentioned the Lamb alone upon the throne (Illustrated.) AE 482.
That by the Lamb is meant the Divine Human of the Lord; and, in the relative sense, the good of innocence. Reference.
The blood of the Lamb = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord. AE 476:2, Explained.
By a lamb is signified innocence.
Like a lamb = ... as if from the Lord.
The celestial goods and derivative truths in which are the Angels in the Third Heaven, were signified by (the sacrifices of) lambs...
The Lamb = the Divine Human of the Lord; here () the Divine which proceeds from the Lord, which is Divine good united to Divine truth in the Heavens; here, therefore, the Divine good...
The Lamb = the Lord as to Divine truth, thus as to the Word, for this is Divine truth. Hence, because it is said Moses and the Lamb, there is signified the Word of the Old and of the New Testament...
Hence... the Lord Himself, from Divine innocence, is called the Lamb.

To fight with the Lamb = to have controversy concerning the holiness of the Word, and concerning the Power of the Lord to save men... And the Lamb shall overcome them = that He will rescue those who want to be instructed and led by Him through the Word.
